# Themes

strata ships 27 themes. Press <Kbd>T</Kbd> to open the picker — the theme changes as you move, and <Kbd>esc</Kbd> brings the old one back. To keep a theme, set it in your config:

```toml
[general]
theme = "tokyo-night"
transparent = false   # true uses your terminal's background
```

## Built-in themes

`ayu-dark` · `catppuccin-frappe` · `catppuccin-latte` · `catppuccin-macchiato` · `catppuccin-mocha` · `dracula` · `everforest` · `github-dark` · `github-light` · `gruvbox-dark` · `gruvbox-light` · `kanagawa` · `monokai` · `nightfox` · `nord` · `one-dark` · `palenight` · `rose-pine` · `rose-pine-dawn` · `rose-pine-moon` · `solarized-dark` · `solarized-light` · `sonokai` · `terminal` · `tokyo-night` · `tokyo-night-day` · `tokyo-night-storm`

The `terminal` theme uses your terminal's own 16 colours.

## Custom themes

A theme is 13 colours; every other colour in the UI is derived from them. Create `~/.config/strata/themes/<name>.toml`:

```toml
# ~/.config/strata/themes/midnight.toml
inherits = "tokyo-night"   # start from any theme, then override

bg      = "#0f1117"
surface = "#171a23"
overlay = "#2a2f3d"
fg      = "#d8dee9"
muted   = "#6b7280"
red     = "#f87171"
orange  = "#fb923c"
yellow  = "#facc15"
green   = "#4ade80"
cyan    = "#22d3ee"
blue    = "#60a5fa"
purple  = "#c084fc"
accent  = "#22d3ee"        # borders, titles and the cursor
```

Colours are `#rrggbb`, `#rgb` or a named ANSI colour such as `red`. A broken theme file is reported when strata starts and the others still load.
